format: Q1 any 4 of 6 x4=16 | Q2 any 3 of 4 x8=24 | Q3 any 3 of 4 x10=30 | total 70, 3h

questions.text: What are the objectives of sharpening spatial filters? Derive the Laplacian operator using image derivatives and draw four Laplacian masks.

State the difference between 4-neighbor, 8-neighbor and m-connectivity. Given a 4x4 binary image segment [(1010),(0101),(1010),(0101)], determine the number of connected components under each connectivity type and discuss the effect of diagonal adjacency on these components.

Define a color image. What is the difference between additive and subtractive color mixing? What is the purpose of color models in image processing? Which model is appropriate or representative for color printing and segmentation?
What is data redundancy in images? Name three main types of it. Discuss one redundancy type that can be overcome using variable-length code words. How to calculate relative data redundancy?

What is the primary goal of edge detection in image processing? Name two gradient-based operators used for edge detection. What is the role of non-maximum suppression in Canny edge detection? What is Region Growing in image segmentation?
Define dilation mathematically for a binary image. Explain the opening and closing morphological operations. What happens when you apply closing to an image with small holes?

For the 5x5 input image [(0 0 1 1 2),(0 1 1 2 4),(1 1 2 4 5),(1 3 4 5 6),(3 3 5 6 7)] of 3 bits, find a transformation function that will approximately equalize its histogram. i) Illustrate it in detail [4] ii) Provide the transformed equalized output image [1] iii) Sketch the transformation curve [1] iv) Draw the input and output histograms [2].

7x7 image segment, 3 bits/pixel; binary images of bit plane 2, 1, 0 given. i) Construct the original image from the bit planes [2]. ii) At the (3,2) point of the original image: Task 1 perform a 3x3 Max filter [2]; Task 2 perform a 3x3 Negative Laplacian filter [2]; Task 3 design a 3x3 spatial mask that averages the 4 neighbors of a point (x,y) but excludes the point itself [2].

i) Uncompressed grayscale image 512x512, 8 bits/pixel; after compression file is 64 KB. Compute compression ratio [1]. ii) Encode the 1-D pixel run AAAAABBBCCDAA using RLE (symbol, count) [1]. iii) 1-D row of length 100 alternating ABAB... (50 A, 50 B). Explain RLE performance and compute encoded length, count stored as one byte [2]. iv) Symbols {A:0.4, B:0.3, C:0.2, D:0.1}: build a Huffman code, compute average code length and compare to entropy [4].

i) 3x3 patch [10,10,10,10,50,10,10,10,10]. Apply the Sobel operator in the horizontal direction; gradient value at the center pixel? [2] ii) In Canny, a pixel has gradient magnitude 80 after non-maxima suppression; double thresholds low=50, high=100. How is the pixel classified? [2] iii) Find the line passing through points (2,1),(3,2),(4,3). Are they collinear? Derive the polar representation of a line used in the Hough Transform. Why is it preferred in the Hough Transform? [4]

Scanned document image suffers from uneven illumination, faded ink and background noise. Task: enhance for readability, then segment text line and text for OCR. i) Describe two enhancement techniques suitable for this case [4]. ii) Which sharpening method (Laplacian or Sobel) would be most effective for this enhancement, and why? [3] iii) After sharpening, which segmentation technique would you use to separate text and text line? [3]

i) Compress a collection of bitmap images with many repeating colors and patterns: choose a fixed-length coding algorithm which is lossless (LZW). Explain step-by-step encoding of the 4x4 8-bit image [7 8 40 100, 7 8 40 100, 7 8 40 100, 7 8 40 100] [6]. ii) 3x3 image of 3 bits f(x,y)=[1,4,3,2,3,4,2,4,5] compressed lossy; after decompression all pixel values increased by 2. Provide decompressed image f_d(x,y). Use appropriate fidelity criteria to evaluate the compressed image and measure the error [4].

A satellite image shows the road networks of the AUST campus, but has noise (small bright spots), gaps in roads and overlapping structures. i) Which morphological operation would you apply first to remove the small bright spots noise, and why? [3] ii) After noise removal roads appear fragmented with small gaps; which operation connects them and how? [3] iii) To highlight the boundaries of roads, develop the most suitable morphological operation [3]. iv) Can highlighting boundaries help distinguish roads from background terrain? [1]

A medical imaging team analyzes X-ray images of bones to detect fractures. They apply chain code representation, histogram analysis, Hough transform and power-law transformation. Discuss how each technique contributes to detection and enhancement of fractures, highlighting applications, advantages or limitations.
